restart_note: a `uvicorn` reload is REQUIRED for the new /api/brain-chat routes to register (in-flight detached runs survive the reload). Not committed.
how_rich_mode_plugs_in: ChatBrain.render(gate_svo) is the single render seam. The endpoint already accepts `rich: bool` and calls chat.render_rich(gate_svo) when ChatBrain exposes it, else falls back to chat.render. So the rich-answer build (the concurrent owner of rich_answer_composer.py) only needs to add a render_rich method to ChatBrain — the /api/brain-chat contract ({answer, abstained, recalled_svo, verified, renderer}) is unchanged and the VERIFY/moat guard still applies.
how_a_real_developed_brain_plugs_in: POST /api/brain-chat with `brain` set to a developed-brain bundle DIRECTORY path (one produced by developed_brain_io.save_developed_brain: brain.json + grounded_codes.npz + facts.json). The endpoint detects the manifest via is_developed_brain_bundle and reconstructs the EXACT brain (its learned grounded codes + stored facts) via load_developed_brain. With a free GPU, set renderer='qwen' (or 'auto') for the fluent off-bridge Qwen surface form. The Interact tab's Brain field accepts that path directly.
